summary: The change correctly recognizes pipe-table rows with optional outer delimiters while retaining the separator requirement and existing outer-pipe behavior.

evidence: `isTableRow` now allows optional leading and trailing pipes while requiring an internal pipe, so `Name | Value` and `--- | ---` match.
The existing table branch still requires `isTableSeparator` on the following line, and that function requires multiple dash-only cells.
`splitTableRow` continues stripping optional outer pipes, so existing outer-pipe tables retain their cell parsing.
